title: Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs
abstract: arXiv:2611.06828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gated-delta linear attention layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), and GDN-2 are tuned for GPUs, where small tensor-core tiles and fast vector registers make per-channel decay rescaling and sequential in-block solves cheap. On Google TPUs, which concentrate compute in wide $256 \times 256$ systolic matrix units backed by a slower vector unit, porting these layers directly leaves half of each matrix tile empty and bottlenecks on vector operations. translated_title: 脉动阵列线性注意力：面向TPU协同设计的分块分组门控Delta注意力
translated_abstract: 门控Delta线性注意力层，如门控DeltaNet（GDN）、Kimi Delta Attention（KDA）和GDN-2，都是针对GPU调优的——在GPU上，小尺寸张量核心瓦片和快速的向量寄存器使得每通道衰减重缩放和块内顺序求解的代价很低。而Google TPU将计算集中在宽256×256的脉动矩阵单元中，并辅以较慢的向量单元，直接移植这些层会导致每个矩阵瓦片有一半空间空置，且性能瓶颈落在向量运算上。我们提出了脉动线性注意力，它围绕矩阵单元重新塑造门控Delta注意力：将键维度扩展到256并采用分组值头，将衰减门分组为四个64通道瓦片，并在单个融合内核中完全通过分块矩阵乘积来计算块求解。在TPU v7x上，一个完整的SLA-R4层比开源的Tokamax KDA内核快1.6倍至2.5倍（使用精确分块求逆时为1.4倍至2.4倍）
tldr: 提出了脉动线性注意力（SLA），针对TPU的256×256脉动矩阵单元重新设计门控Delta线性注意力——将键扩展至256、把衰减门分组为64通道瓦片并用全分块矩阵乘法的单一融合内核计算——在TPU v7x上比Tokamax KDA内核快1.6至2.5倍。
en_tdlr: Systolic Linear Attention (SLA) co-designs gated delta linear attention for TPUs' wide 256×256 systolic matrix units by widening keys to 256 with grouped value heads, grouping decay gates into 64-channel tiles, and computing the chunk solve entirely with block matrix products in a single fused kernel, achieving 1.6×–2.5× speedup over the Tokamax KDA kernel on TPU v7x.
